english_description: A tiny from-scratch FluffOS learning lib (LPC practice yard) by dzpao. Not a game: no accounts, rooms, or combat. Connecting drops you at a prompt with look/score/hello/test/quit; fb tries a local instance socket on 127.0.0.1:8000. Not collection scratch or imud.
